This release removes the need for go-dockerclient and thus eliminates a lot of dependencies.
This release upgrades the docker images and forces moby dependency to make this more consistent.
Dockertest now runs with native docker for windows and osx.

body.name: v2
body.body: With v2, we removed all Open\* methods to reduce duplicate code, unnecessary dependencies and make maintenance easier.

body.name: Legacy API support
body.body: This tag is primarily for legacy applications which are still relying on `Open` and `Setup` methods.
